body.name: \widehat{\mathcal Q}_{x,n}(\alpha)
body.construction: \(\widehat{\mathcal Q}_{x,n}(\alpha)=\bigcup_{p\in\mathcal C_n(\alpha)}Q_x^*(p_x)\). Compute the union by enumerating reduced primal--dual active bases, retaining the semialgebraic parameter cell on which each basis is feasible and optimal, and projecting its rational optimizer map onto \(\Delta_K\).
